Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are back in the middle. Martin Guptill and Henry Nicholls are the openers for New Zealand. Fred Klaassen to start with the ball.
...THE RUN CHASE…

Netherlands were coming against a top bowling team. Both the openers played some superb strokes and were finding the gaps but not for long as both fell inside the 10-over mark. They found themselves railing at 45 for 5 and the 80-run stand between Michael Rippon and Pieter Seelaar was much needed. The runs came at a slower rate but they made sure of putting a respectable total against strong opposition. Pieter Seelaar fell but Michael Rippon went on to score his half-century and added some crucial runs with the lower order. This is still a par score but Netherlands bowlers have something to defend now. Quick wickets early on might just put some pressure on the Kiwis. An exciting chase coming up shortly. Stay tuned.

Blair Tickner is up for a quick chat. He says that it was a good outing for him. He adds that the last month or so has been good for him. Tells that he has 14 four-fers and three five-fers in the first class, so he is used to missing out on fifers. He mentions that the pitch is on the slower side and it is holding up a little. Says that it is nice to have his family watching the game.

A decent bowling performance from the host. You don't see New Zealand miss their lengths and lines much often and today was another day of their disciplined bowling attack. The pacers showed resistance in the beginning and all of them got a wicket each. In the middle phase, the spinners came in, they failed to take the wickets but made sure the run rate was below check. New Zealand let a partnership grow but it was soon broken by the debutant, Blair Tickner who had a dream outing as he took four wickets while giving away 50 runs. Others too accompanied him with a decent performance and Tom Latham will be happy with the performance and fancy chasing it down.

The 200-run mark is breached and Netherlands will be very happy with the score, looking where they were at one stage. All thanks to Michael Rippon who played a fighting knock along with some crucial partnerships with the lower order. Still, New Zealand will fancy chasing it down, looking at the fire-power they have.

OUT! CAUGHT! Netherlands get bowled out! A low full toss on off. Michael Rippon looks to heave it away over deep mid-wicket. However, he fails to get the timing and Martin Guptill moves to his left and takes a fine catch. The umpires check for the height of that full toss but it seems below waist-height so Kyle Jamieson finishes with three wickets and Michael Rippon is the last man to get out. It has been a good innings by him. Netherlands finish with 202!
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Kyle Jamieson

Commentary.Commentary: A slower length ball, outside off. Michael Rippon swings across the line but gets deceived by the slower delivery. Latham fails to collect it cleanly too but no run taken.

NO BALL! Michael Rippon backs away and Kyle Jamieson serves it wide outside off. A length delivery and Michael Rippon fails to get bat on it. Kyle Jamieson has overstepped and a Free-hit is coming up.
A short delivery on middle. Brandon Glover mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Another edge and another boundary! Lands on a length, around leg. Glover makes room and looks to hit it away. The ball catches the thick outside edge of his blade and goes way for a boundary towards third man.
Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on leg. Brandon Glover flicks it to fine leg for a single. End of a very good spell on debut by Blair Tickner.
Lands on a length, around off. Brandon Glover looks to punch it away but misses.
A short delivery on off. Rippon looks to pull but gets a cue end of his blade. A single taken towards the third man region.

FOUR! Another boundary, bit lucky this time. Goes slightly fuller on off. Michael Rippon swings across the line but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races away towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Michael Rippon dabs it behind the stumps on the off side.
SIX! Take that Blair Tickner! A length delivery on middle. Michael Rippon clears his front leg and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
Serves a length delivery on middle. Brandon Glover works it towards mid-wicket.
Lands on a length, around off. Michael Rippon steers it towards short third man for a single.
Brandon Glover is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fred Klaassen looks to go big but fails to get any timing and gives away his wicket. This is short on off. Fred Klaassen looks to pull but is slightly hurried by that short ball. Fails to get the timing and ends up hitting it towards long on. Colin de Grandhomme charges forward and takes a good low catch. Nine down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Colin de Grandhomme b Kyle Jamieson

Commentary.Commentary: Michael Rippon backs away again and Kyle Jamieson follows him. Bowls a very full delivery on the pads. Michael Rippon flicks it to square leg for a single.
On a length, around leg. Fred Klaassen works it to fine leg for a single.
A slower yorker on leg. Michael Rippon makes room and digs it out towards the off side for a single.
Kyle Jamieson (8-1-35-1) is back on.
Short ball, on off. Rippon tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A slower bouncer on middle. Rippon leaves it alone.
Angles a length ball, on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Fred Klaassen again tries to push it away to covers but misses it.
Short in length, around off. Fred Klaassen looks to push on the up but misses it.
A length ball, outside off. Rippon cuts it late to third man for a single.
Blair Tickner (8-0-35-4) is back on.
Shorter and spinning back in, outside off. Fred Klaassen punches it to cover.
Full again, this time Rippon drills it to long on for a single.
Very full from 'round the wicket. Rippon pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Quicker, outside off, pushed to point.
Fred Klaassen is the next man in.
OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A soft dismissal! Flatter ball, on off. Philippe Boissevain looks to work it on the leg side and but gets a leading edge, straight back to Bracewell who takes it with ease.
Shorter and flatter on off. Rippon pulls it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Philippe Boissevain skips down the track and looks to go big downtown but mistimes it short of long on for a single.
Slower in the air, on off. Philippe Boissevain gets across and looks to paddle-sweep it but ends up missing it.
Slower in the air, around off and it's a googly. Philippe Boissevain looks to defend but gets the inside edge onto his pads.

Fifty for Michael Rippon. What a superb innings this is! Fighting a lone battle and he would love to give the finishing touches! Tossed up, angling on middle. Rippon looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge to point and he scampers across for a quick single.
A googly, quicker and on off. Rippon punches it back to Sodhi.
Tossed up, on off, pushed to covers.
Flatter and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Floated on off, driven to mid off for a quick single.
A fuller delivery on off. Philippe Boissevain sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and  just short of the fielder for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Philippe Boissevain blocks it out.
Full toss on off. Rippon pushes it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery, on off. Michael Rippon pushes it to covers for a single.

Dropped but a difficult chance for the bowler on his own bowling. A fuller delivery on off. Philippe Boissevain hits it hard right of the bowler. Sodhi takes his right hand out to catch it but fails to pouch it.  A single taken between mid off and mid on.
A flatter delivery on off. Philippe Boissevain blocks it out.
FOUR! Good shot this time. On middle and fuller. Philippe Boissevain sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Lovely delivery, a leg-spinner. Pitches it on off. Philippe Boissevain presses forward to defend but the ball turns away and beats him.
A fuller delivery on middle. Michael Rippon works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Philippe Boissevain pushes forward to defend but misses.
Flatter and around off. Philippe Boissevain blocks it out.
Shorter on off.  Philippe Boissevain pushes it to covers.

On off and turning into the batter. Philippe Boissevain looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes towards the third man region for a couple. Tom Latham, in the meanwhile appeal for LBW but the umpire signals that there is bat involved.
Shorter delivery on middle. Philippe Boissevain pulls it to square leg.
A fuller delivery, outside off. Philippe Boissevain looks to drive but misses.
On middle. Philippe Boissevain works it to mid-wicket for a single.

Another appeal and another googly. This is pitched on off and Philippe Boissevain looks to defend again but misses again. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal but it is too high and the umpire turns it down.
Review! New Zealand take a review for LBW! No bat there. Ball Tracking shows the ball goes onto miss the leg stump. Not out it is.

NOT OUT! Ish Sodhi serves a googly again. This is fuller on off and it turns back. Philippe Boissevain looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal but the umpire says no again. However, this time New Zealand take review. The replays roll in and the Ball Tracker shows that the ball is missing stumps. So the original decision stays and Philippe Boissevain will continue.

Googly this time! Slower in the air and fuller on middle. Philippe Boissevain looks to work it towards the leg side and the ball loops up in the air. Tom Latham comes forward and takes a catch. Appeals but the umpire turns it down.
Goes flatter and quicker outside off. Philippe Boissevain cuts it to covers.
Slightly shorter delivery, around off. Rippon cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Ish Sodhi is back on.
Short of a length and on off. Boissevain looks to defend but it takes the shoulder of the bat and balloons over the keeper. The batters take two runs. A good throw would have made things interesting.
Length ball, outside off. Rippon opens the face of the bat and dabs it past backward point for a single.
Length ball, on off. Rippon guides it to point.
Full ball, on middle. Boissevain flicks it aerially and to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off, pushed straight down the ground and the mid off fielder dives to his right and cuts it off. A single taken.
FOUR! A much needed boundary and 150 is up for Netherlands! Fuller and on the pads. Rippon flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, cut to point.
Wide! Down the leg side. Boissevain misses his flick.

Very full and on middle. Boissevain pushes it to mid on and Rippon looks for a quick single but was sent back. The fielder there scores a direct hit but the replay shows he was just inside his crease.
Philippe Boissevain is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Blair Tickner has his fourth wicket, what a debut this is! A length ball, slower one again and on middle. Logan van Beek just chips it straight in the hands of Will Young at mid on who takes it comfortably. He tried to clear the fielder but got deceived by the slower ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Will Young b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: A superb yorker, on off. Logan van Beek squeezes it out to point and takes a quick couple of runs. Blair Tickner thinks it went off the boots but it was off the bat.
An appeal for LBW but not given! This is full and straying on the pads. Logan van Beek misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. Was clearly going down.
A length ball, outside off. Logan van Beek slaps it nicely but finds cover.
Jamieson keeps it tight, on middle with a length ball. Rippon bunts it to mid-wicket.
Fuller at 111 clicks, on middle. Rippon is touch early as he nudges it to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, flicked behind square for a single.
Fuller, slower and on middle, Logan van Beek pushes it gently to the left of mid on.
On a length, outside off. Logan van Beek knocks it to covers.
Length ball, angling on off. Logan van Beek defends on the back foot to point.

Around off, fuller, Rippon drives it to cover.
Length and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
SIX! It is hit or miss time for Logan van Beek! Another short ball, outside off. Logan van Beek upper cuts, not off the middle but enough to clear the third man fence. A biggie.
FOUR! Logan van Beek will take it however it comes! A short ball, on middle. Logan van Beek looks to pull but gets a top edge to fine leg for a boundary.
Wide! Fullish delivery, way outside off. Logan van Beek looks to drive but misses. A wide given and Blair Tickner is not happy with the decision.
Length and on off. Logan van Beek keeps it out.
A length ball, outside off. Michael Rippon punches it to the left of the cover fielder who puts in a superb dive and allows only a single.
A length ball, on off, pushed to covers.
On middle, on a length, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
A direct hit and Logan van Beek is a goner! Full and on off, this is pushed to mid off. Logan van Beek wants a single but was sent back and the fielder there misses his shy.
On a length and on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Good shot! Bangs a short ball, on off. Rippon waits and ramps it over the keeper for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, Rippon plays it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, on middle. Logan van Beek blocks it out.
WIDE! A length delivery and down the leg side. Logan van Beek lets it go.
Logan van Beek is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Blair Tickner comes back into the attack and strikes, he breaks the partnership. Pieter Seelaar, the skipper played quite well but has to walk back now as he tries to tuck it around the corner. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Pieter Seelaar gets across and looks to tuck it away. However, he gets a faint part of his blade and Tom Latham moves to his left slightly to take an easy catch. The extra pace did the trick there.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: On the shorter side again, close to off. Rippon rides the bounce and punches it left of mid off for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Pieter Seelaar cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Rippon steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Rippon is early to work it towards the leg side and gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Blair Tickner is back into the attack.

FOUR LEG BYES! Good nasty short ball but a boundary off the helmet in the end. This is on the off stump line. Pieter Seelaar tires to get off the way but the ball hits his helmet and deflects towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Bangs it short, around off. Pieter Seelaar looks to pull but misses.
Serves a slower length ball, around off. Rippon steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length, on middle. Rippon works it to mid-wicket.
Goes fuller on off. Rippon drives it to mid off.
Lands a length delivery, outside off. Pieter Seelaar pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Rippon drives it back to the bowler.
Goes slightly short and flatter again, around off. Pieter Seelaar punches it to covers for a single.
Shorter and flatter outside off. Rippon cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Pieter Seelaar sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

NO BALL! Tossed up on off. Rippon looks to drive it away but gets the inside edge to fine leg for a single. A front foot no ball given and a Free-hit will follow. Sodhi hit the stumps while delivering the ball and a Free Hit coming up.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Rippon cuts it to point.
Goes slightly short on middle. Rippon pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Kyle Jamieson runs to his left and dives to stop it. Two runs taken.
Update 8.40 am IST (3.10 am GMT) -  The sky looks pretty clear so it should not be a long delay. And the players are back on the field. We are ready to resume...
Update 8.37 am IST (3.07 am GMT) - It has started raining and the umpires call for the covers. A bit heavy at the moment but only the pitch is covered. Looks like a passing shower...
Another short delivery, around off. Pieter Seelaar sways away from the line of the ball and lets it go again.
It has gone dark out there.
Bangs it short, on off. Pieter Seelaar sways away from the line of the ball.
Back of a length, outside off. Michael Rippon punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bangs it short on middle. Pieter Seelaar looks to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air but falls short of the fine leg fielder for a single.
Lands on a length, on middle. Rippon works it to fine leg for a single.

On a length, around off. Pieter Seelaar dabs it to point and sets off for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end and the ball hits Pieter Seelaar's leg. It goes towards long off. Extra run not taken off an overthrow just a single.
Matt Henry (5-1-20-1) is back into the attack.
Tossed up on off. Pieter Seelaar drives it to long off for a single.
Slightly shorter outside off. Pieter Seelaar punches it to covers.
FOUR! Good shot! This is fuller on middle. Pieter Seelaar sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
This one is quicker and turns away a bit. Sodhi drops it a bit short as Pieter Seelaar looks to come down the wicket. He defends it in the end.
Slower in the air and fuller outside off. Rippon drives it to long off for a single 100 up for Netherlands!
Short and wide outside off. Rippon cuts it to point.

A tossed up ball, outside off. Seelaar tries to drag it but gets a top edge over square leg. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but Seelaar was well inside his crease as he takes his second run.
Full and on middle. Seelaar stays back and blocks it out.
Seelaar takes a big stride forward as he defends this full ball to covers.
FOUR! This is full and on middle. Seelaar sweeps it past short fine leg and the ball races away into the fence.
Quicker one, on a length and turning on leg. Seelaar rocks back to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but it was going down.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Fuller and angling down. Seelaar sweeps it to fine leg for one more.
Shorter and around off, this one skids through. Seelaar looks to punch it but gets a thick outside edge past first slip and to third man for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle. Seelaar keeps it out.
Flighted, on middle. Rippon strides forward to defend but gets an inside edge to square leg. A single.
This one lands outside off and spins back in. Rippon on the back foot hits it to covers.
Quicker one, on middle. Seelaar leans and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Full and outside off. Seelaar slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, slanting on off. Seelaar looks to push it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Very full and outside off. Seelaar steps across and looks to sweep it but misses.
Floated, on middle. Seelaar comes inside the line of the ball and pushes it to mid-wicket.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Angles a full ball, on middle, worked to long on for a single.
This one turns the other way, shorter and around off. Seelaar is cramped for room as he looks to cut it.
A googly, on middle. Seelaar punches off the back foot to covers.

Tossed up, full and on middle. Seelaar skips down and drills it to long off for a single.
A leg breaker, not much turn available though, around off. Seelaar drives it straight to covers.
Slower, fuller and on off. Defended to covers.

Given some air this time, on middle. Michael goes back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
This is full and angling on off. Rippon smashes it straight to covers.
Quicker, flatter and outside off. Seelaar punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, on off, driven to covers.
Too full and outside off, drilled to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off. Pieter Seelaar looks to drive again but gets the inside half of his blade and the ball goes towards mid on.
Slower in the air, around off and it's a googly this time. Pieter Seelaar doesn't pick it and drives it off the inside half of his blade towards the leg side.
Pushed quicker on middle. Rippon works it to fine leg for a single.
Nicely bowled. Good loopy delivery on off. Rippon defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off. Pieter Seelaar drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Rippon works it to fine leg for a single.

Tossed up on off. Pieter Seelaar skips down the track and drives it to covers.
Slightly slower in the air, around off. Pieter Seelaar gets a good stride forward and defends it.
A quicker delivery on off. Pieter Seelaar blocks it out.

Slower in the air and fuller on off. Pieter Seelaar defends it off the front foot.
A flatter delivery on middle. Michael Rippon works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A half-tracker on middle. Rippon rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Lovely delivery to start. Loopy delivery on off. Rippon defends it towards the leg side.

Slightly shorter delivery, outside off. Pieter Seelaar cuts it to backward point for a single.
On off and fuller. Rippon pushes it to long on for a single.
Pitches this around off and a slight turn for the off-spinner. Rippon goes across and looks to paddle sweep it but misses.The ball hits his pads and there is a slight appeal but nothing serious.
A flatter delivery on middle. Rippon works it towards mid-wicket again.
A tossed up delivery, outside off. Rippon works it towards mid-wicket.

Back of a length, around off at 127.5 kph. Pieter Seelaar dabs it towards the off side.
A short delivery on off. Rippon pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Seelaar drives it on up through covers. The batters run three.

Length ball, around off. Rippon defends it solidly.

This time Seelaar finds the gap! Outside off, Seelaar punches it through cover-point for a brace.
On a length, outside off. Seelaar punches it to covers.

Good running! A length ball, on middle, Rippon pushes it to mid on and runs across to complete the run.

Drinks!  It's been a sorry story for Netherlands so far. New Zealand bowlers have bowled good lines and lengths but more often that not it has been the case of Netherlands batters playing poor shots. Half of the side back to the hut now and Netherlands need a big partnership here if they want to post a decent score on this good pitch against a strong Kiwi batting lineup.
On a length, on off. Kept out.
What a bouncer from Tickner! This is short, extra pace and around off. Seelaar sways away from it and losses his balance in the process as well. Seelaar finds himself on the deck.
On the pads again, this time Seelaar defends it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off, hit through covers for a single.
Shortish and outside off. Rippon drops his wrists and lets it through.
A loosener, on the pads. Seelaar flicks it past square leg. The fielder gives a chase and flicks it back near the ropes. Three runs taken.

On a length, on middle. Pieter Seelaar works it towards mid-wicket.

OUT! CAUGHT! Blair Tickner gets another one and almost the same way he got his first. This is poor batting. Back of a length, outside off. Bas de Leede tries to use the pace of the ball and looks to guide it over third man by opening the face of his blade. However, there is no way he can clear the fielder at third man and ends up hitting it straight to it. Colin de Grandhomme there takes a good catch and five down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Colin de Grandhomme b Blair Tickner

Michael Rippon is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another one bites the dust and Colin de Grandhomme strikes in his second ball. This is a fullish delivery on off. Probably not that full to drive but Scott Edwards goes for a drive. He plays it a tad early and ends up hitting it back to the bowler. Colin de Grandhomme takes a good return catch and Netherlands are in all sort of trouble now.
Serves a length delivery, on off. Scott Edwards walks down the pitch and defends it.
Colin de Grandhomme is into the attack now.
Back of a length, around leg. Scott Edwards works it to fine leg for a single.
Lovely delivery again! A good-length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes at it tentatively but gets beaten off the outside edge.
Lands on a length, on middle at 142.5 kph. Scott Edwards works it towards the leg side.
Bangs it short, around off at 144 kph. Scott Edwards looks to pull it but misses.
Another effort delivery! Back of a length, on middle at 140 kph. Scott Edwards works it towards the leg side.
Who will be the next batter in? Scott Edwards it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Blair Tickner gets his first ODI wicket! Poor shot by Singh, he was looking so good but has to walk back now. This is short and outside off at 144 kph. Singh tries to use the pace and upper cut it. However, he fails to get enough distance and ends up hitting it straight to Ish Sodhi at third man. He takes a good catch and three down now, Netherlands.
Commentary.Howout: c Ish Sodhi b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: PowerPlay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Goes fuller on off. Bas de Leede drives it to mid off.
Goes slightly fuller, on off. Bas de Leede drives it to covers.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede defends it solidly towards the off side.
A length delivery on middle. Bas de Leede defends it towards the leg side.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede drives it off the front foot but gets a thick outside edge to point.
Serves it on a length, on off. Bas de Leede defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Goes fuller outside off. Singh leans forward and creams it through cover-point for a boundary.
This time good pacy delivery! A good-length delivery, outside off at 145 kph. Singh looks to punch it away but gets beaten off the outside edge of his blade.
Back of a length and angling into the body from 'round the wicket. Singh defends it square off the wicket on the off side.
Lands on a length, on middle. Bas de Leede works it to fine leg for a single.
Short and wide. Singh cuts it firmly to third man for a single. He is looking quite impressive on debut.
Back of a length, around leg. Bas de Leede works it right of square leg for a single.
Blair Tickner is into the attack now.
Back of a length, around off. Singh blocks it towards the off side.
FOUR! This time an even better shot! Slightly shorter length, around off. Singh stays in his creasea and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. Classy from Singh.
FOUR! Beautifully timed! Henry goes slightly fuller on off. Singh leans forward and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Lands on a length, around off. Singh punches it to cover-point.
Extra pace and bounce. Henry bangs it short on off at 139.3 kph. Singh sways away from the line of the ball.
Goes slightly short on off. Singh goes back and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede rides the bounce and defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is short, on off. Bas de Leede hangs back and pulls it firmly to deep square leg for a boundary.
A good-length delivery, around off. Bas de Leede pushes it to covers.
A good-length delivery that pitches around off and it nips back in. Bas de Leede looks to defend but the ball jags in and hits Bas de Leede high on his pad.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
A fullish delivery and down the leg side. Bas de Leede looks to clip it but misses. There is an appeal from behind the stumps but no damage done.
Absolute ripper to end the over! Lands on a length, around off. Singh presses forward to defend but the ball seams away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
On a length, around off. Singh blocks it out.
FOUR! Good soft hands! On a length, around off. Singh dabs it wide of slip and in the gap between gully and slip for a boundary towards the third man fence.

Almost a wicket again! On a length, around off. Bas de Leede pushes it to covers and sets off for a single. The fielder runs in and has a shy at the batter's end. He misses and Vikramjit Singh is safe. Single taken. However, if that would have hit the stumps, Singh would have been in trouble.
Bas de Leede walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant catch by Martin Guptill! Henry gets his first wicket now and Netherlands are in early trouble here. A good-length delivery, around off and it is angled across the batter, Stephan Myburgh punches it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes left of gully and Martin Guptill there dives and takes a good low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Henry lands on a length, on off. Stephan Myburgh drives it to mid off.
Good comeback from Kyle Jamieson after going for a boundary! On a driving length, outside off. Singh misses his drive.
Same line and length as the previous delivery but this one moves away off the seam. Singh gets beaten on the outside edge as he looks to defend.
Tight from Jamieson! On a length and around off. Singh defends it out.
On the hips, Myburgh works it to fine leg for a run.
Short of a length, on top of the off stump! Myburgh looks to punch but misses.
FOUR! Both the batters are finding the gap beautifully! A full ball from around the wicket, outside off. Myburgh bends forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Lovely shot to get off the mark! This will give him good confidence! Fuller and on off. Singh drives it through cover for a brace.
Lovely delivery! Short and angling on middle. Singh can't do much but sway away from the line.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Uppish but safe! A length ball, outside off. Myburgh looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge, past gully and to third man for a single.
On a length and outside off. Myburgh looks to cut but misses.
Short in length and on off, Myburgh strokes it off the back foot to covers.
Length and on off, Singh punches it to covers.
Vikramjit Singh walks in at number 3. He is on debut.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! O'Dowd has given away his wicket here. It was just a regular delivery! Short and down the leg side. O'Dowd pulls it without much power on it, just trying to tickle it away but the ball brushes his gloves and Tom Latham, behind takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Kyle Jamieson

Commentary.Commentary: A straight ball, full and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Bangs a bouncer, outside off. O'Dowd shoulders arms to it.
This is on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! First shot of aggression and Myburgh gets a boundary! Fuller and on off. Myburgh caresses it through covers.
This one just nips back in, fuller and around off. O'Dowd gets a straight bat down to block it.
Length ball, just around off. O'Dowd this time stays back and guides it to point.
Fullish and on off. O'Dowd defends it on the front foot.
Pitched up, on off. O'Dowd strides and hits through the cover region for another couple of runs.
Netherlands and Max O'Dowd are underway! A length ball, outside off. O'Dowd leans and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Ripper! A length ball, angling outside off and makes it to shape away. O'Dowd looks to push it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Matt Henry will share the new ball with Kyle Jamieson.
A maiden to start with! This is on a length, around off. Myburgh punches it to covers.
On a length, on middle, pushed to mid on.
A bouncer, across on off. Myburgh sits under it.
This one shapes back in and was on the shorter length, on middle. Myburgh looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge.
No swing yet, length and way outside off. Myburgh shoulders arms to it.
A length ball, angling outside off. Myburgh leaves it alone.

We are done with the anthems and it's time for cricket to takeover. New Zealand players are there in the middle. Max O'Dowd and Stephan Myburgh are the openers for Netherlands. Kyle Jamieson to start with the ball for New Zealand. Here we go...
Time for national anthems! It will be Netherlands first followed by New Zealand's. It's a great opportunity for Dutch and they will be looking to put a good score on the board.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Will Young, Ross Taylor, Tom Latham (C) (WK), Michael Bracewell, Colin de Grandhomme, Ish Sodhi, Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry, Blair Tickner.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Stephan Myburgh, Max O'Dowd, Vikramjit Singh, Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (WK), Michael Rippon, Pieter Seelaar (C), Logan van Beek, Philippe Boissevain, Fred Klaassen, Brandon Glover.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Netherlands. They have elected to BAT first.

New Zealand, on the other hand, will be eyeing this series as the one to strengthen their bench strength ahead of an ODI World Cup next year. They are missing the services of many of quite a few frontline players but their is enough experience and quality in their young guns to put a dominating performance in this series. This is also the last time we will see Ross Taylor in international cricket and we can expect the legend to finish his illustrious career on a high. The first game of a three-match series is always important and it will be interesting to see how both teams go about their business. Can Netherlands pull of a spirited performance and start the series with a victory? Or will the Blackcaps dominate on their home turf? We shall find out. Toss and team sheets in a while.

Netherlands will be touring New Zealand with the hope of securing some important World Cup Super League points. However, they need their experienced players to step up if they want to make an impact in this series. They have a quality bowling attack with the likes of Logan van Beek and Fred Klaassen in their lineup. Though much will depend on how their batters go about their business and Max O'Dowd will have an important role to play in that aspect.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI of this three-match ODI series between Netherlands and New Zealand. It’s a great opportunity to see Dutch boys going up against a quality full-member nation and series like this will go a long way in developing Netherlands cricket and associate cricket as a whole.
... MATCH DAY …
